verdict_reason: The rename from commoditySelection to commodityCode/speciesLatinName is correct, but the new complete-line fixture is copied across three test files and stores speciesLatinName in a shape production never writes, and two test titles over-claim.

todos.issue: completeCommodityLine (line 29) is the third copy of the same complete 0102/Bos taurus commodity line fixture: bridge/collection-complete.test.js:27 (completeLine) and engine/evaluate/collection-view.test.js:7 (completeLine) define it again, so the next change to the line shape has to be made in three places
todos.fix: Must: one shared test helper owns the complete (and partial) commodity line fixture, and every test that needs it imports it; the local copies are deleted. One way: export completeCommodityLine and partialCommodityLine from a commodities test-support module (for example beside features/commodities/search/test-support.js) and import it in indexed.test.js, collection-complete.test.js and collection-view.test.js

todos.issue: completeCommodityLine stores speciesLatinName as an array (['Bos taurus']), but production stores a string: commit-selection.js seedLine copies speciesLatinName from the search row, which rows.js sets to species.latinName. The completeness tests at lines 64 and 181 therefore prove readiness for a line shape the app never writes, against the ticket AC that frontend stub data matches the reference-data response
todos.fix: Must: the commodity line fixture has the shape seedLine writes (speciesLatinName a single Latin-name string, commodityType from typeIdFor). One way: speciesLatinName: 'Bos taurus', or build the line with seedLine(BOS_TAURUS_ROW) plus the page answers

todos.issue: Two titles claim more than their assertions prove. Line 43 'Should enumerate sub-obligations at every depth via walkObligations' asserts only depth 0 (commodityLines) and depth 1 (commodityLines.commodityCode, .numberOfAnimalsQuantity); the depth-2 animalIdentifiers obligations are not asserted. Line 143 '... as OPTIONAL (not Completed, does not count)' asserts only toBe(OPTIONAL); nothing checks the section does not count towards readiness
todos.fix: Must: each title states exactly what its assertions prove. One way: add an assertion for a depth-2 path (for example commodityLines.animalIdentifiers.animalIdentifierEarTag) or retitle to 'Should enumerate commodity line sub-obligations via walkObligations'; drop '(not Completed, does not count)' from line 143's title or add a readyForCheckYourAnswers assertion that proves it
